title: Space-sampled Value Decay: Forgetting Mechanisms for Non-stationary Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.11797v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning agents deployed on physical systems must adapt continually, since degradation and shifting environment conditions change the dynamics (they \emph{drift}) over time. In the hardest version of this problem, the agent interacts with a single system that might drift at every timestep, leaving no opportunity to revisit past conditions -- a setting we call Single Environment, One-Shot Non-Stationary Reinforcement Learning (SEOS-NSRL). We argue that this setting calls for selective forgetting rather than re-learning, and introduce Space-sampled Value Decay (SsVD), which pulls value estimates of randomly chosen elements of the state space to a baseline value, so that outdated information in non visited regions is discarded. SsVD does not require resetting or change-point detection and plugs into modern off-policy algorithms; we integrate it into Soft Actor Critic and Deep Q-Networks. Across 6 non-stationary environment

translated_title: 空间采样值衰减：面向非平稳强化学习的遗忘机制
translated_abstract: 部署在物理系统上的强化学习智能体必须持续进行适应，因为系统退化与环境条件的变化会随时间改变系统动力学（即发生“漂移”）。在这个问题最困难的版本中，智能体与单一系统交互，而该系统可能在每个时间步都发生漂移，使智能体没有机会重新经历过去的条件——我们将这一设置称为单环境一次性非平稳强化学习（SEOS-NSRL）。我们认为这一设置需要的是选择性遗忘而非重新学习，并提出了空间采样值衰减（SsVD），该方法将状态空间中随机选取元素的值估计拉向一个基线值，从而丢弃未被访问区域中的过时信息。SsVD无需重置或变点检测，并可直接嵌入现代离策略算法；我们将其集成到Soft Actor-Critic和Deep Q-Networks中，并在6个非平稳环境中进行了验证。
tldr: 提出空间采样值衰减（SsVD）这一选择性遗忘机制，通过将状态空间中随机采样元素的值估计拉向基线值来丢弃过时信息，无需重置或变点检测即可使离策略强化学习算法适应持续漂移的单环境非平稳系统。
en_tdlr: Introduces Space-sampled Value Decay (SsVD), a selective forgetting mechanism that pulls value estimates of randomly sampled state-space elements toward a baseline value, enabling off-policy RL algorithms to adapt to continuously drifting single environments without resets or change-point detection.
